title: Baku Military Court sentences former Nagorno-Karabakh leaders to life imprisonment
body:
Caucasian Knot reported on 5 February 2026 that the Baku Military Court had sentenced six former Nagorno-Karabakh officials to life imprisonment. They were Arayik Harutyunyan and Bako Sahakyan, both former presidents, Davit Babayan, former foreign minister, Levon Mnatsakanyan, former Defense Army commander, Davit Manukyan, his deputy, and Davit Ishkhanyan, former parliament speaker.

The trial of 15 former Karabakh officials had ended on 31 October 2025. The charges covered more than 20 articles of the Azerbaijani Criminal Code and 2,548 counts, including planning or waging aggressive war, genocide, deportation or forced transfer of population, torture, wilful murder, terrorism and terrorism financing, and creating unlawful armed groups. The prosecution had requested life sentences for Harutyunyan, Ishkhanyan, Babayan, Mnatsakanyan and Manukyan, and terms of 16 to 20 years for the others.

The defendants denied guilt in their final statements, made in December 2025, and their lawyers argued that guilt was unproven. Former president Arkady Ghukasyan was among the 15 defendants, but the report did not give his sentence. The case of Ruben Vardanyan, former State Minister of Nagorno-Karabakh, was being heard separately.
